description_en: A historic public library with heritage reading rooms and exhibition spaces.

name_en: The Ian Potter Centre: NGV Australia
description_en: An art gallery at Federation Square focusing on Australian art.
highlights_en: Australian and First Peoples art, gallery spaces and changing exhibitions.
opening_hours: Daily 10:00-17:00. The November capture lists ANZAC Day opening at 13:00 and Christmas Day closure.
admission_notes_en: State Collection entry is free; some exhibitions have admission charges.

accessibility_notes_en: Street-level automatic-door entrances, lifts to each floor and accessible toilets on all levels. Free wheelchairs can be reserved at the Information Desk. No down escalator at NGV Australia. Scooter hire is not confirmed for this venue.
visit_scope: NGV Australia at Federation Square; NGV International on St Kilda Road is excluded.

description_en: A museum exploring film, television, videogames and screen culture.
highlights_en: The Story of the Moving Image, interactive displays and the Lens experience.
opening_hours: Regular museum hours: daily 10:00-17:00; Christmas Day closed. The December capture lists ANZAC Day 13:00-17:00. Game Worlds extended hours and cinema sessions are programme-specific.
admission_notes_en: General museum entry is free; some exhibitions, films and events have separate tickets.

accessibility_notes_en: Flinders Street ramp, lifts to all levels and accessible toilets on Ground Floor and Level 1. Free wheelchair loan requires ID at the information desk. The surrounding cobbled plaza may be difficult with mobility aids.

description_en: A museum in the Old Customs House exploring migration and cultural identity.
highlights_en: Migration stories, Customs House history and exhibition spaces.
opening_hours: Daily 10:00-17:00; Good Friday and Christmas Day closed.
admission_notes_en: Adult AUD 15; children up to 16, eligible concessions and members free. Australian Seniors Card holders: AUD 10 on 3 February; AUD 12 on 7 December. Exact change date unknown; older overseas visitors do not qualify by age alone. Some programmes cost extra.
booking_notes_en: Order Up tickets were sold online and onsite in the 6 October announcement. Advance reservation of borrowed wheelchairs or a scooter was recommended. General admission advance-booking necessity or exemption remains unconfirmed.
accessibility_notes_en: Market Street ramp approaches to the main entrance and courtyard; automatic doors and lifts to gallery levels. Accessible toilets on ground and first floors. Free wheelchairs and a mobility scooter can be reserved; heritage-door and scooter turning-space limitations apply.
